name: audio_detection.v1
description: Detects and classifies audio events from a raw waveform.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the input waveform in Hz.

id.description: Class IDs for each detected event, ordered by descending probability.

score.description: Confidence score for each class per detected event, ordered by descending probability.

name.description: Class name encoded as UTF-8 bytes per detected event, ordered by descending probability.

frame.description: Temporal bounding frame in seconds for each detected event (t, t_end).
